# openEMS results (generated by report.py)

Inductance of the PBV-R001 shunts as the INA241 inputs read it, computed on the routed copper (shunt_coupling.py; method checked by validate_mutual.py). What input k reads, with the three phase currents summing to zero:

    V_k = R I_k + jw (L_k I_k + D_k (I_p - I_q))      (k, p, q) = (U, V, W), (V, W, U), (W, U, V)

R = 1 mOhm comes from the datasheet: the copper model has no resistance. L_k does not depend on how the current returns through the other two phases; D_k is the coupling from them.

## Inductance per phase

| Phase (shunt / amplifier) | L, foil model (nH) | L, body with a metal back (nH) | D, foil model (nH) | R = jwL at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| U (R1 / IC2) | 2.43 | 2.36 | +0.21 (I_V - I_W) | 66 kHz |
| V (R4 / IC4) | 2.31 | 2.26 | +0.02 (I_W - I_U) | 69 kHz |
| W (R7 / IC6) | 2.72 | 2.66 | -0.18 (I_U - I_V) | 59 kHz |

The last column is where the inductive part equals the 1 mOhm (foil model): above it, the reading follows dI/dt more than I. The PWM runs at 24 kHz in simulation 07.

## Where the flux goes through (foil model, current in on U, back on V)

| Input | Under the body, above the board | Inside the board | Kelvin tracks on L6 | Sum | Read at the port |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| U | 1.96 nH | 0.19 nH | -0.09 nH | 2.05 nH | 2.21 nH |
| V | 1.96 nH | 0.15 nH | 0.09 nH | 2.20 nH | 2.33 nH |

Integral of the H field over the surface of the loop at 50 MHz. The field maps are about 2 % low (validate_mutual.py); the sum is compared with the port reading as a check.

## Checks

- Body = foil only: the three drives add up to -0.002 / -0.003 / +0.004 nH on inputs U / V / W (should be 0).
  m varies by 6.2 % at most over the band and the real part stays below 0.9 % of the imaginary one: a plain inductance.
- Body with a metal back: the three drives add up to -0.002 / -0.003 / +0.004 nH on inputs U / V / W (should be 0).
  m varies by 6.2 % at most over the band and the real part stays below 0.6 % of the imaginary one: a plain inductance.
- Mesh: with 0.15 mm instead of 0.2 mm in the fine window (drive UV, foil model), the inputs read U 2.218 instead of 2.212, V -2.407 instead of -2.331, W -0.386 instead of -0.359 nH: the inductances above hold to about 3 %.
- The drive current goes through the shunts of the driven phases (current up pin 1 / up pin 4, per ampere driven, drive UV): R1 +1.015 / -1.020, R4 -1.016 / +1.021.
- validate_mutual.py: two loops in one plane, openEMS within 1.2 % of the Neumann integral.
- Thin-wire bracket for input U (filament_bracket), the body current running along the bottom of the body: 4.26 nH, or spread over the height of the body: 1.17 nH.
